The '''Moorsh Moraine''' was a glacial feature located on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Hoth]], the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army|Army]] used the moraine as a [[staging area]] while numerous [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruisers]] ferried Imperial personnel towards the planet.<ref name="Twilight Company">''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''</ref><ref name="GD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Moorsh Moraine was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] source-book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' and made its first appearance in ''[[Entrenched]]'', a Legends [[Star Wars comic books|comic]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref><ref name="Entrenched">{{StoryCite|story=Entrenched|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref> The moraine was confirmed to be [[canon]] when it was mentioned in the [[2014]] mobile-game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Defense]]''.<ref name="GD" />
